classes.name: GovernedSubjectLifecycleModule
classes.description: Deep private Chisei module whose interface owns fixed-profile Governed Subject evaluation replay, canonical receipt ordering, receipt reconciliation, signing-key lifetime policy, Tenkai provenance issuance, and append-only export persistence.

classes.name: GovernedSubjectEvaluation
classes.description: Fixed-profile payload-free conformance evaluation that reconciles through one canonical operation receipt.

classes.name: GovernedSubjectProvenanceExport
classes.description: Situation-specific signed Tenkai provenance derived from one fresh authoritative Governed Subject allow receipt without granting execution authority.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates Governed Subject callers, translates protobuf messages, and delegates evaluation and provenance behavior to the private lifecycle.

relations.name: delegates_governed_subject_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The Chisei gRPC transport delegates Governed Subject evaluation and provenance export to the lifecycle module.

relations.name: governs_subject_evaluation_lifecycle
relations.description: The lifecycle owns canonical Governed Subject evaluation replay and receipt ordering.

relations.name: governs_subject_provenance_export
relations.description: The lifecycle reconciles authoritative evaluation receipts into situation-specific signed provenance exports.
